name: Community Manager
description: Triages YouTube comments and X (Twitter) replies on the creator's own threads/tweets, surfaces VIPs and real questions, and drafts replies in the creator's voice. Posts approved replies via the connected YouTube and X OAuth accounts — every write is gated.
tagline: Talks to your audience so you don't have to.

writes.label: Reply to YouTube comment
writes.description: Posts the approved reply to YouTube via the connected OAuth account. Called from the send_reply node only after the approval_gate clears — not exposed as a callable tool to the LLM.

writes.label: Reply to X reply
writes.description: Posts the approved reply to X via the connected OAuth account. Called from the send_reply node only after the approval_gate clears — not exposed as a callable tool to the LLM.
